topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Flowers on the doorstep, no note. That's the kind of thing that'd make some folks wonder, maybe even smile. Not me. I just picked them up, gave them a once-over. Roses, fresh as they come. But who sent them? That's the question. Could be a friend, a secret admirer, or someone who wants to send a message. Thing is, in this city, you never know. I put them in a vase, let them sit there in the silence. Whoever it was, they picked a good day to reach out. Maybe they knew the rain would keep the world at bay for a little while. I’ll figure it out, sooner or later. Everything's got a story, even a bunch of flowers.
